# Non-template files that a PR may change in addition to templates.
# Changes to any of them require manual maintainer approval, see
# .github/workflows/non-template-changes.yml.
#
# One bash glob pattern per line, matched against the repo-relative path.
# "*" also matches "/", so "dir/*" covers everything below dir/.
# Blank lines and lines starting with "#" are ignored.
#
# The list is always read from the base branch, so changes to it take
# effect only after they are merged.

README.md
AGENTS.md
.github/*
